description: 翻译服务抽象层 — 统一 ITranslationProvider / IAiTranslationProvider 接口、领域错误码与 11 家多供应商工厂（阿里云 / 百度 / 腾讯云 / 有道 / DeepL / Google / OpenAI 兼容 / Anthropic / 通义 / 百度大模型 / 火山引擎）

PostgreSQL store for Stellaegis.Trash (schema trash): items per compartment or shared, payloads encrypted with pgcrypto, row-level security, the schema installed and verified through Stellaegis.Primitives.Data.

ASP.NET Core endpoints for Stellaegis.Trash: put, list, read, restore and delete, mapped on a group the host provides in the space the host resolves; the purges apart, as administration acting on compartments.

A generic trash for an application: a serialized object goes in with its identity, comes back out to be recreated under the same identity, or is purged after its deadline. Isolated per compartment or shared, every call under an actor.
Architecture rules for .NET, enforced at compile time by Roslyn analyzers.
The robbiblubber.org Console Utility Library provides console application utility classes.

Language Server Protocol server for RuleScript (.rules) files.
